graham.brief:
Last week TreVeyon Henderson's touches fell from 16 to 9. Where did Henderson's work go? A lighter role like that would make Henderson's early games the wrong baseline. Across the season Henderson still has 44% of the New England carries.

As the underdog, New England could be giving Henderson fewer carries once the fourth quarter arrives.

Henderson's rush attempts line this week is 9.5, well under the 12 he averaged over two games. The spread and the 49.5 total work out to about 21 points from New England. His recent workload is one explanation, and a noisy two-game baseline for Henderson is the other.

Most of the New England carries going to Henderson would back his average, and a rotation would back the line. Watch who takes the first-down handoffs for New England, since a changing role shows up there first.
